The '''heavy blaster rifle''' was a larger, more powerful version of the [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] often used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]].

==Description==
The heavy blaster rifle was well suited to battles on open terrain but not close-quarters fighting because of its large size. It was one of the most powerful type of blaster rifles, however the greater power came at a cost of a lower ammunition capacity of 30 shots.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> The heavy blaster rifle included a single-shot mode and an autofire mode for rapid automatic fire, as well as a close range [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting. The most popular model included the [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]] which was used during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Other models included the [[StarAnvil heavy blaster rifle]] and the [[RT-97C heavy blaster rifle/Legends|RT-97C heavy blaster rifle]].

==History==
Heavy blaster rifles were used by [[cold assault battle droid]]s<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commanders]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />
